title: Algebraic properties of overflow semirings
summary: We introduce the overflow semiring $S = A \uplus_{\operatorname{ord}} L$, extending a positive information algebra $A$ by a join-semilattice $L$, where elements of $L$ dominate $A$ and arithmetic in $L$ reduces to the join. This models overflow in computational systems and generalizes the transition from finite to infinite cardinal arithmetic.
